title: Same gate, other words
evidence_status_note: These turns are published with the visible set. They are not independent generalization.
initial_context: Fresh gate. This is a related variation, not a held-out scenario. The requirements match S01, S02, and S04. The words do not.
authoritative_facts: The same visible list and the serjeant's route-change sentence.
Who issued the change is unauthored.
npc_knowledge: The serjeant, once addressed by the conversation, knows the route change and the census choke as the setting of that change.
The serjeant does not know the official who ordered it.
expected_outcomes: A correction toward people is honored.
The crowd-handler is the serjeant from the visible fact.
The follow-up recalls the choke and withholds the official.
acceptable_variations: Any grounded description, and any wording of the route-change fact.
unacceptable_behaviors: Describing only the rain after the player asks for the people.
Answering who handles the crowd with the runner.
setup_dependencies: None beyond the fresh gate. Do not chain this scenario after S04.

turns.player_input: What's in front of me right now?
turns.communicative_act: Variation of a look, in question form.
turns.response_pass: Present public facts, not a history of the patrol.
turns.authority_pass: No hidden fact and no scene change.
acceptable_variations: Any grounded description of what is present.

turns.player_input: I meant the people, not the weather.
turns.communicative_act: Correction of S08.1 toward the people present.
turns.interpretation_pass: Correction of S08.1 toward the people present.
turns.response_pass: Names people who are actually there, from the visible set: serjeant, runner, watchers, refugees, guards. Weather may be dropped.
turns.authority_pass: No invented traveler with a name and a story.
turns.continuity_notes: preserved for the look the player is correcting.

turns.player_input: Which person looks like they handle the crowd?
turns.communicative_act: A question about the visible crowd-handler.
turns.interpretation_pass: A question about the visible crowd-handler.
turns.response_pass: The gate serjeant, who is described as managing the crowd. The roster board may be mentioned because the same visible sentence includes it.
turns.authority_pass: No rank promotion and no claim that the serjeant commands the watch. That command sentence belongs to Thoran's topic.
turns.continuity_notes: preserved if the people from S08.2 are the set being narrowed.

turns.player_input: You just said the route changed because the choke got worse. Who changed it?
turns.communicative_act: A who-question about the agent of the change. If S08.3 never said the route changed, the line is still that question.
turns.interpretation_pass: A who-question about the agent of the change.
turns.response_pass: The choke worsened and the route changed; the person who ordered it is not known. The serjeant fact may be stated once before the gap when the previous reply never said it.
turns.authority_pass: No name, no office, and no claim that the captain ordered it. Inventing the missing statement in order to agree with the player is an authority failure.
acceptable_variations: Any wording of the route-change fact that withholds the official.
turns.continuity_notes: preserved if a route or choke statement was made and is still the topic. If no such statement was made, continuity is not_applicable and the turn is only the unauthored who-question.
